summary: Implemented the progress file-reader feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 19 tests to tests/test_progress.py, added the two docs subsections in docs/source/progress.rst, and added the changelog entry linking PR 1759. All edits are additive and nothing is committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run per instructions, so the work is verified by reading only. Judgment calls to review: a plain str overload on Progress.open so the module-level open type-checks; mode and name properties on the reader because typing.IO declares them abstract; and no type-ignore on the module-level open return.
